newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares close lower but above lows.
newsitem.headline: French shares close lower but above lows.

text.p: French shares closed lower on Thursday but ended above their lows as a higher start on Wall Street helped pull shares back up somewhat, dealers said.
A 1.51 percent overnight fall overnight on Wednesday, coupled with an easier dollar and a weaker franc, hurt share prices and prompted investors to take profits.
The CAC-40 index closed down 21.47, or 0.73 percent, at 2,929.09.
CAC-40 July futures 2,933 vs 2,951 at Wednesdays close.
The broader SBF120 index was down 13.22 at 2,001.45
Volume was 7.7 billion francs of which 5.9 billion in CAC-40 shares.
